name: Rope Climb
hook: Roped together. One slip drags you all down.
how: Climb a tall tower as a team, tied together by a rope. Grip to hold on when a partner slips, haul them back up, and climb as high as you can before time runs out.
controls: Arrows or A/D to walk, Space to jump, hold Shift or S to grip (grip + Space hauls); on touch, ◀ ▶, Jump and Grip
uses: The highest climbs, measured by the team's lowest climber.
The host's browser picks the tower, ties the rope, runs the timer and keeps the team's best height; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot partner climbs with you when you're alone: it waits for you, grips when you fall and hauls you up.
Everyone climbs the same tower, and the rope pulls on each climber as their partners move.
ideas: Add falling rocks that knock climbers off the wall
Make the tower a frozen ice cliff with slippery ledges
Give each climber a single rope boost that throws a partner upward
